title: Zesty Flaky Algerian Rice Paella
description: A flavorful and flaky Algerian dish featuring paella rice, umami taste, and a nimono-simmer method, all wrapped in a pandan leaf for a unique presentation. This meal is perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the paella rice and stir to combine with the mushroom mixture.
Add the vegetable broth, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Prepare the pandan leaves by cutting them into large squares and brushing with water.
Spoon the rice mixture onto the center of each pandan leaf square and fold the leaves to form a triangle or a square shape.
Serve the Zesty Flaky Algerian Rice Paella hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
